t: You're on Hans Road, a street in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It takes its name from Sir Hans Sloane, the physician, naturalist and collector. He bequeathed his collection of 71,000 items to the British nation, which became the foundation of the British Museum, the British Library and the Natural History Museum. The solicitor Arnold Heseltine also died on this street, in 1897, a quieter local footnote beside Sloane's famous name.
